_source: The safe zone of 争锋频道, read from the client's environment prefab env_025_act1enemyduel (battle/prefabs/[uc]envsystems.ab) and the boundary-line effects it lists (common_V060_line_1…4 in battle/prefabs/effects/common.ab). These numbers are not in ArknightsGameData; they are game data (© Hypergryph), recorded here for the sim — see NOTICE.md.
_zones: half-extents in tiles around the centre tile, one entry per shrink: the boundary effects frame 9×7, 7×5, 5×3 and 3×1 tiles
_buffTiles: outside the zone, tile_infection_dqq gives ATK ×(1+atk), ASPD +attack_speed and move speed ×move_speed (the level's env_system_new rune); the start and end tiles give the same without the move speed
